title: The Hollow Vector
author: Ivo Voss
blurb: Odile Underhill, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
